name: Planning with Files
description: Persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents and long-running tasks. Crash-proof markdown plans, session recovery after /clear and compaction, per-turn re-injection against context rot, deterministic completion gate. Manus-style. Install from npm, the DipoleML plugin marketplace, or npx skills. Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, 60+ agents.
